notes: scan057.N1: This page opens section 3, Stratifications globales : introduction aux tubes, with dark authorial page 16 and pale other-hand foliation 56. It introduces tubular-neighbourhood notation and the sets R_i and R_{i,j}, adds a large marginal formula (3bis), and gives a proof ending in the claim (4). The heading is physically on this assigned page; only this page's C and H packets were read.

scan057.N2: The introduction assumes i≤j, while R_{i,j}=R_i∩X_j is defined for i,j∈I. The later comparison R_{ij}∩X_i=R_i∩X_i uses the initial i≤j and the forward implication i≤j⇒X_i⊂X_j. No converse implication from inclusion to order, injectivity of i↦X_i, or nonempty-star reduction is assumed in this isolated reading. The proof itself displays X_k∩X_i=⋃_{ell≤k,i}X_ell. The boundary convention dot X_i=⋃_{ell<i}X_ell is the interpretation used for the conditional checks below; its global hypotheses are background, not established on this page.

scan057.N3: Targeted check of (2): under the written interpretation of overline V_{ij} as a neighbourhood inside X_j, it is a subset of X_j. Then overline V_{ij}∩R_{ij}=overline V_{ij}∩(R_i∩X_j)=(overline V_{ij}∩X_j)∩R_i=overline V_{ij}∩R_i. This checks the final equality by associativity of intersection. The actual meaning of the ell decoration is not reconstructed from mathematics.

scan057.N4: The underbrace calls R_i a closed part of X. This follows if I is finite and each X_k is closed in X, because R_i is a union of a subfamily of finitely many closed sets. This is a conditional check only: those global hypotheses are not restated on scan057 and were not independently recovered from another page by this reader.

scan057.N5: Targeted check of (3bis), without injectivity or strictness: assume i≤j, the forward order-to-inclusion implication, and X_k∩X_j=⋃_{ell≤k,j}X_ell. A point of R_i∩X_j lies in some X_k∩X_j with X_k not containing X_i, hence in X_ell for ell≤k,j. Such ell cannot equal j, since then X_i⊂X_j⊂X_k, a contradiction. Thus ell<j. Also X_ell cannot contain X_i because X_ell⊂X_k. Conversely a term X_ell with ell<j and X_ell∩X_i≠X_i lies in both R_i and X_j. This proves the union identity and, under the boundary convention, containment in dot X_j. Duplicate closed pieces do not invalidate this argument.

scan057.N6: The page's proof establishes the forward inclusion R_i∩X_i⊂dot X_i under its displayed intersection formula. For X_k not containing X_i, every ell≤k,i satisfies ell≠i (otherwise X_i⊂X_k); hence ell<i, and X_ell⊂dot X_i. Taking the union over k gives the asserted forward inclusion. The comparison R_{ij}∩X_i=R_i∩X_i additionally uses i≤j. The claimed reverse inclusion is not automatic from forward order-to-inclusion: the immediate termwise argument requires each lower X_ell, ell<i, to fail to contain X_i. This is a sufficient condition for that argument, not a claimed necessary condition for equality in every family. Strictness X_ell⊊X_i for ell<i is a sufficient extra hypothesis; with it, every lower X_ell lies in R_i∩X_i and the reverse inclusion follows. This isolated report therefore does not certify (4) unconditionally. The subsequent cross-page counterexample and sufficient refinement are recorded in scan057.N12 and scan057.N13.

scan057.N7: After donc the ink reads X_k∩X_i⊂dot X, without subscript i. The neighbouring dotted-X_i terms and the argument suggest intended dot X_i, but the locally absent index is not supplied. This is an apparent authorial omission, not a reason to regularise the line.

scan057.N8: All seven proof occurrences of the index letter have closed ell loops, including the crossed ell<i. They are rendered as ell individually. The cancelled first V trial in (2) remains a tentative bare scripted V with the barred form as an alternative; no extra star is reconstructed from crossing hatch. The cancelled R_j, two upper signs, first X_k under the union, abandoned union/tel q, and et in the crossed proof phrase retain their local doubts.

scan057.N9: The marginal formula rises steeply from left to right. Its upper-right X_k⊂dot X_j continues the union after R_ij= and is not a separate proposition after On a aussi. The underline ends under k< before j; no final point follows the marginal formula. The two-line R_i partie fermée de X annotation belongs to the underbrace in (3), not to the left marginal NB note.

scan057.N10: The citation has readable § and 1 followed by an overwritten or retraced closer. Extra loop/cross strokes and a small upper dot are recorded as a doubt on that closer; no second old letter or numeral is invented. Uncertainty-only additions to aux and the closer, and removals of doubt for M1002/M1003, are not substantive C text changes. Reclassifying pale56 from mspage to margin also is not a C textual correction.

scan057.N11: The earlier hypothesis on scan045 is a locally finite family of closed pieces, so the closedness assertion for R_i does not need a finite index set. Every subfamily remains locally finite. At a point outside its union, take a neighbourhood meeting only finitely many members and remove those finitely many closed members; the resulting open neighbourhood misses the union. Thus R_i is closed under the supplied global hypothesis.

scan057.N12: The unqualified equality (4) fails for an unreduced family allowed on scan049. Let I={0<1} and X_0=X_1={p}. This finite closed cover satisfies (21c,d), but dotted X_1=X_0={p}, while R_1 is the union of pieces not containing X_1 and is empty. Hence R_1 intersect X_1 is empty. The author calls the reverse inclusion triviale; the counterexample shows that qualification is needed. The ink is preserved unchanged. A sufficient refinement is recorded in scan057.N13.

scan057.N13: A sufficient refinement of (4) is strict lower inclusion: ell<i implies X_ell is properly contained in X_i. Then each lower X_ell lies in R_i, giving the reverse inclusion; scan057.N6 proves the forward inclusion. The optional restriction on scan055 to indices with nonempty X_i^* supplies this strictness, because X_ell=X_i for ell<i would make X_i^* empty. It even makes the retained family reflect order: if retained X_i is contained in retained X_j, a point x of X_i^* has least containing index i and also belongs to X_j, so i≤j. No adoption of that optional reduction is asserted or inserted into the manuscript.

scan057.N14. Blind adjudication explicitly qualifies the small replacement R/a in (2), while retaining its insertion state, indices and cancelled upper sign. The tall looped superscript in (1) is ell by same-page comparison. The top serif of I is not a second bar; the marginal R_ij, singular tel que, and partial underline remain literal. A comma supplied by both witnesses after the last formula on the implique line is removed because no corresponding mark is present. The unindexed dotted X and the conditional mathematical discussion above are unchanged.
